title: What kind of file is this?
description:
Write `file_type(data)`: `data` is a list of a file's first bytes (numbers 0 to 255). Return the format from its magic number, or `"unknown"`:

| Starts with | Return |
|---|---|
| `0x89 0x50 0x4E 0x47` | `"png"` |
| `0xFF 0xD8 0xFF` | `"jpeg"` |
| `0x25 0x50 0x44 0x46` (`%PDF`) | `"pdf"` |
| `0x50 0x4B 0x03 0x04` (`PK..`) | `"zip"` |
| `0x4D 0x5A` (`MZ`) | `"exe"` |
| `0x7F 0x45 0x4C 0x46` | `"elf"` |

`data[:4] == [0x89, 0x50, 0x4E, 0x47]` compares the first four items. The list may be shorter than a signature.
